normalization_plan.reason: characterType is only used inside addCharacters to index costs/values and is normalized into that function
the local amount is a temporary of the addCharacters purchase loop
knightID is the attacker selector consumed only by fight
knightIndex is a gas-saving hint consumed only by fight
base_probability is the result of the integer arithmetic identified as unsafe in fight
dice is the random roll compared to the probability inside fight
amount is the owner-supplied withdrawal size consumed only by collectFees
sender is the token spender processed inside the receiveApproval callback
value is the approved token amount checked inside receiveApproval
callData is decoded by toUint32 to obtain the character id
characterId selects the character sold by sellCharacter
howmany is the per-eruption kill count computed inside triggerVolcanoEruption
pot is the accumulated value passed to distribute
random is derived from the weak randomness generator used for victim selection
newOldest is the scan result written back to the oldest state variable by findOldest
shares is the output of the integer distribution arithmetic identified as unsafe
newOwner is the address assigned to the owner inside transferOwnership
knightPower is computed from external token balances inside fight
playerBalance is the amount transferred out by the external call in exit
